review:
A 2016 nine-line game run by a gang of cats, with lines paying both ways so wins land more often.

Wild Night can randomly drop fully expanded wilds on any combination of reels 1, 2 and 3, and every free spins win is multiplied by 4x. The headline is the RTP: a huge 98.1%, one of the highest of any slot anywhere. An older game, but brilliant for long, low-stakes demo sessions.
pros: Excellent 98.10% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
